resources.string: Zeliard needs its original game files (ZELRES1.SAR, ZELRES2.SAR, ZELRES3.SAR, GAME.BIN and the rest). They are copyrighted and not included with this app.\n\nPick the folder that holds them, or a .zip of that folder. They are copied into the app; file names may be in any case.
Choose the game files again. New files replace the old ones; your saves are kept.
Those files do not look like Zeliard: ZELRES1.SAR, ZELRES2.SAR and ZELRES3.SAR were not found.
